details.further_information: Eligible for the United States, Nigeria, and Ghana. D.C. United can receive up to an additional €1m in add-ons plus a sell-on percentage of 20% from Bournemouth. Matai Akinmboni is the nephew of Samuel Kuffour (Retired).
